programs.title: It's beautiful here
programs.desc:
Dorota Szelągowska will visit unique places in Poland, the existence of which only insiders often know.The host will prove that it is never too late to fulfill your childhood dream and live in a tree house, at least for a while.For those who value greater comfort, he will show luxurious interiors created, among others, by:in an old cotton fabric factory.Viewers will also meet the owners of these charming places, who will tell their stories and reveal how they managed to implement their unique plans and projects.Many of them abandoned life in big cities to be able to do what they love most, i.e. interior design and running unique guesthouses.Dorota Szelągowska will look into every nook and cranny of these original objects, reveal interior design ideas to the viewers and prove that there are many wonderful places in Poland that are truly beautiful.
Dorota Szelągowska visits Pabianice.Thanks to many years of revitalization works, the former building of a cotton fabric factory now houses the "Fabryka Wełny" hotel.The presenter will assess the effect of the designers' efforts, who had to combine modern design with elements reflecting the past of this place.At the same time, they could not forget about comfortable conditions for guests.Then Dorota Szelągowska will try the dishes served in the hotel restaurant and talk to the musicians working there.

programs.title: Asian Times
programs.desc: Julian Hanton visits Asia.It checks what changes are taking place on the continent, where economic recovery goes hand in hand with population growth.The leader begins his journey in Hong Kong, where he inadvertently agrees to take a punch from Bruce Lee.This experience will be remembered for a long time.In Thailand, he makes friends with investigative journalists, becomes a secret agent and monitors local gambling.In the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and China, he carefully observes people and their behavior.He discovers that all corners of the world are an inexhaustible source of knowledge.
